title: #031. Weighted N-Queens
subtitle: Place N non-attacking queens on a weighted chessboard using distinct() and element indexing on Pumpkin CP.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { cols, totalCost }.
judge.m3: Column {p0} contains more than one queen; all queens must be in distinct columns.
judge.m4: Queen at row {p0}, column {p1} attacks an earlier queen along a diagonal.
judge.m5: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed board cost ({p1}).
judge.m6: Valid non-attacking queen placement, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
